title: DDProperty Scraper Input
description: Search DDProperty Thailand. Provide Start URLs to use them directly, or fill in the filter fields to build the search automatically.

startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional — overrides filters below)
startUrls.description: Paste one or more DDProperty search URLs here. If provided, all filter fields below are ignored.

listingType.title: Listing Type
listingType.description: Search for rental or sale properties.

bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Select one or more bedroom counts. Leave empty for any.

minPrice.title: Min Price (฿)
minPrice.description: Minimum price in THB. Leave at 0 for no minimum.

maxPrice.title: Max Price (฿)
maxPrice.description: Maximum price in THB. Leave at 0 for no maximum.

minSize.title: Min Size (sqm)
minSize.description: Minimum floor size in square metres. Leave at 0 for no minimum.

maxSize.title: Max Size (sqm)
maxSize.description: Maximum floor size in square metres. Leave at 0 for no maximum.

propertyType.title: Property Type
propertyType.description: Filter by property type. Leave as Any to include all types.

distanceToMRT.title: Max Distance to MRT/BTS (km)
distanceToMRT.description: Filter by maximum walking distance to nearest MRT/BTS station. Leave as Any for no filter.

freetext.title: Area / Keyword
freetext.description: Free-text area or keyword search, e.g. Ekkamai, Thonglor, Sukhumvit.

isCommercial.title: Commercial Properties Only
isCommercial.description: Toggle on to search commercial listings only.

maxListings.title: Max Listings
maxListings.description: Maximum total listings to scrape. 0 = unlimited.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Concurrent browser tabs. Keep at 2-4 to avoid blocks.
